name: Dimensional Prophecy of Zohar Redux Layer 1: Essence
source: Future humanity is in conflict with a mysterious, incomprehensible alien species which is defined as terrorists by the government. A group of mathematicians developed an algorithm which can predict the behavior of the attackers. A young lonely girl should become a new member of the institute but when she arrives at Kyoto Novalis, the aliens attack and she gets lost in the city. Hilal, her new guardian, a female cyborg, searches her in the city, but they don't have much time, because the government ordered a nuclear attack on the city if the aliens can't be stopped in time.   (Source: Itch.IO page and https://cyberpunkdatabase.net/movies.php)
translation: 在未来，人类与一种神秘而难以理解的外星物种陷入冲突，政府将对方认定为恐怖分子。一群数学家研发出一种算法，能够预测袭击者的行动。一名孤独的年轻女孩，本应成为研究所的新成员，却在抵达京都诺瓦利斯时，遭遇外星人袭击，迷失于城中。她的新监护人，女性半机械人希拉尔，正在城市里寻找她。然而，留给她们的时间已经不多，政府已下令，若不能及时阻止外星人，就将对城市发动核打击。（来源为itch.io页面及https://cyberpunkdatabase.net/movies.php）
